description: NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF 2.0) Governance, Control Ledgers (GV, ID, PR, DE, RS, RC), Threat Response Playbooks & Zero-Trust Verification

recommended_surface_bindings.description: NIST CSF 2.0 6-function control mapping (GV/ID/PR/DE/RS/RC), immutable security evidence ledgers, and Business AAA incident response SOPs
invariants: Every security policy, control, or audit statement maps 1:1 to a NIST CSF 2.0 subcategory ID (GV.*, ID.*, PR.*, DE.*, RS.*, RC.*) recorded in corporate/ledgers/security-controls.md
Incident response and zero-trust verification playbooks follow the Three-Part Business AAA structure (# Scope & Surface Target, # Normative Invariants, # Verification & Sign-Off Gates)
Secrets, private keys, and internal network topologies never cross into public surfaces/ or outbound promotion diffs

Technological application surfaces (src/**, scripts/**, Dockerfile) and custom MCP capabilities enforce OWASP ASVS boundary validation, non-root containers, PATH_CONTAINMENT_VIOLATION guards, and strictly-read-only subagent sandboxes
